title: "Unsupervised learning": Boxplots of normal and uniform noise

cues.en: Instructor: This video is an unsupervised learning project.
cues.zh: 這部影片是個「非監督式學習」專案。

cues.en: That means I'm going to give you a suggestion for what to do.
cues.zh: 意思是，我會給你一些建議，告訴你可以做什麼。

cues.en: You can write some code, you will make some graphs, and think about the results.
cues.zh: 你可以寫程式、畫圖，並思考結果。

cues.en: But I'm not going to tell you my solution, I'm not gonna tell you what the answer is, and I'm not gonna do your work for you.
cues.zh: 但不會提供我的解法、不會告訴你答案，也不會替你完成工作。

cues.en: So this is your chance to apply and expand your knowledge that you are gaining from the past few lectures.
cues.zh: 這是應用並擴展前幾堂講座所學知識的機會。

cues.en: Okay, so in the previous lecture, you learned how to make box plots or box and whisker plots and what I want you to do in this code challenge
cues.zh: 前一堂學過如何畫盒形圖、盒鬚圖。這個程式挑戰，我希望你，

cues.en: is to generate basically two box plots that are right next to each other on the same graph.
cues.zh: 在同一張圖上，並排畫出兩個盒形圖。

cues.en: So you see here is six box plots all next to each other.
cues.zh: 這裡看到六個並排的盒形圖。

cues.en: And I want you to create a new figure that's just gonna have two box plots.
cues.zh: 我要你建立一張只有兩個盒形圖的新圖。

cues.en: And those two box plots are going to come from random numbers that are drawn from different distributions.
cues.zh: 這兩個圖的隨機數，要來自不同分布。

cues.en: The first distribution will be a Gaussian, or it's also called a normal distribution, also called a bell curve distribution.
cues.zh: 第一種分布是高斯，也叫常態分布，或鐘形曲線分布。

cues.en: And the second distribution is gonna come from what's called a uniform distribution.
cues.zh: 第二種則來自均勻分布。

cues.en: Now, if you are already familiar with these distributions, and that's great, you already have a bit of an expectation for what the results should be.
cues.zh: 如果已經熟悉這些分布，很好，你對結果應該已經有些預期。

cues.en: If you are not familiar with these kinds of distributions, then don't worry, I'm going to teach you about them later.
cues.zh: 如果不熟悉，不用擔心，稍後會教。

cues.en: The point now is just to get some experience interpreting data and inferring what you can about a dataset purely based on looking at the box plot.
cues.zh: 目前重點，是累積解讀資料的經驗，只根據盒形圖，推論資料集的特性。

cues.en: Okay, so I'm gonna give you a little bit of a hint, which is how to create these random data.
cues.zh: 給一點提示，說明如何建立這些隨機資料。

cues.en: So the MATLAB code for this is for dataset one, you wanna use randn.
cues.zh: MATLAB程式碼中，第一個資料集使用randn。

cues.en: The N stands for normal, so normal distribution.
cues.zh: n代表normal，也就是常態分布。

cues.en: And for dataset two, you just use the function rand without an N, that's gonna create a uniform distribution.
cues.zh: 第二個資料集，使用沒有n的rand函式，產生均勻分布。

cues.en: Here you see the Python code.
cues.zh: 這裡是Python程式碼。

cues.en: So this is in MATLAB but this is Python code.
cues.zh: 雖然顯示在MATLAB裡，但這是Python程式碼。

cues.en: And this is basically the same thing.
cues.zh: 基本上是同一回事。

cues.en: So this would be the Python code for a normal or Gaussian distribution.
cues.zh: 這是常態或高斯分布的Python程式碼。

cues.en: And this is what the Python code looks like for a uniform distribution.
cues.zh: 這是均勻分布的Python程式碼。

cues.en: So again, create a new figure with two box blots, one from a normal distribution, one from a uniform distribution.
cues.zh: 再提醒，建立一張有兩個盒形圖的新圖，一個來自常態分布，一個來自均勻分布。

cues.en: And just by looking at the box blots, see what you can understand about the nature of these two different distributions.
cues.zh: 只看盒形圖，看看能了解這兩種分布的哪些性質。
